name: Bridge abutment and level joins
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "WLD-BRIDGE-JOINS-001 — Bridge abutment and level joins". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing bridge-to-building/tower/terrain interfaces beyond original span/decor kits

The sheet supplies missing connection/support views; bridge master straight span and ornaments reused. Dry solid construction, no river scene, clean actual join ends.
